title: Google launches Genie 4, a world model powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash designed to generate interactive AI simulations, initially as a preview to trusted testers (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Google launches Genie 4, a world model powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash designed to generate interactive AI simulations, initially as a preview to trusted testers — The Genie 4 world model offers more realism and can create audio to accompany its interactive worlds.
